1.explanation:
• src/ol/control/Attribution.js: This control walks through layer states and collects attributions for all layers whose state.visible flag is true, but it doesn’t check whether those layers are inside a hidden group.  
• src/ol/layer/Group.js: The group’s recursive getLayerStatesArray implementation creates a state.visible based only on each layer’s own visible flag, without propagating the parent group’s visibility. Child layers therefore report visible=true even when their parent is hidden, causing Attribution.js to include their attributions erroneously.
1.bug_scenario:
When a group layer is turned off (invisible) but one of its child sub-layers remains on (visible) and has attributions configured, the info popup (‘i’ control) still shows those attributions—even though the parent group is invisible and nothing from that group should appear.

In the screenshot: 1) The top-level group “SEZON OFF/ON” is unchecked (invisible), 2) its child “budynki sezon” remains checked (visible) and has an attribution defined, and 3) the attribution text still appears in the bottom popup.

2.explanation: The Attribution control (Attribution.js) builds its attribution list by walking every layer in the map, but it only checks each layer's own .getVisible() flag. It never checks whether any parent Group layer is hidden. The Group layer implementation (Group.js) and the general Layer state merge logic in Layer.js provide the mechanism for computing a layer’s effective visibility (including parent groups), but the Attribution control bypasses that and assumes independent visibility. To fix the bug, Attribution.js must use the resolved layer state (from Layer.js) or explicitly walk up the group chain (Group.js) to confirm a layer is truly visible on the map before including its source attributions.
2.bug_scenario: When you have a group layer (SEZON) set to invisible (checkbox unchecked) but one of its sub-layers (budynki sezon) set to visible, the info-popup still shows the WMS attributions for that sub-layer even though the parent group is hidden. In the screenshot you can see the group “SEZON OFF/ON” is off, the sub-layer “budynki sezon” is on, yet the popup at the bottom still reads “SEZON: Budynki …” – it shouldn’t appear when the group is invisible.
